title: Pear, Blue Cheese and Gruyère Pizza on a Rye Crust
changes_from_base: A nutty rye and wheat dough replaces the plain base, and two layers of paper-thin pear with grated Gruyère and crumbled blue cheese stand in for the tomato sauce and mozzarella.
summary: Rye-enriched dough supporting delicate layers of pear with the contrasting saltiness of blue cheese and nutty Gruyère.

ingredients.item: plain flour, plus 2 tbsp for rolling
fine sea salt or table salt
fine cornmeal or semolina, for dusting

steps.title: Activate
steps.text: Combine 355 ml lukewarm water in a warm bowl with 2 tsp dried yeast and 1 tsp dark brown sugar, stir and leave for a few minutes until bubbles form.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: In a large bowl, combine 90 g rye flour, 345 g plain flour, 1 tsp salt and 15 ml oil; pour in the yeast mixture and mix until a rough dough forms.

steps.title: Knead
steps.text: Turn the dough onto a floured surface and knead for about 10 minutes until it loses its stickiness, adding small amounts of flour as needed.

steps.title: First rise
steps.text: Shape into a ball, place in an oiled bowl, cover with cling film and leave in a warm spot for 45 to 60 minutes until the dough has roughly doubled in size.

steps.title: Second rise
steps.text: Knock back the dough, shape it again and leave for about 30 minutes until roughly doubled again; meanwhile, peel the 4 pears, rub with cut lemon, halve them, scoop out the cores and slice paper-thin.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Set the oven to 260 °C; knock back the risen dough and divide into 3 pieces; roll each to a 25 to 28 cm circle and place on tins dusted with cornmeal or semolina.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Lay the first layer of pear slices in tight circles leaving a 2.5 cm border, scatter one third of the 200 g Gruyère over each, add a second thinner layer of pear and divide the 180 g crumbled blue cheese among the three, then brush the borders with 55 g melted butter.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until the crust is golden and the cheese bubbles across the surface.

tips: Slice pears paper-thin so they cook evenly without becoming tough or mushy
Anyone pregnant should use a pasteurised blue cheese; check the label.
Brush the crust border generously with melted butter so it browns well and adds richness to every bite
storage: Keep leftovers chilled and eat within 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
